description: This file defines the UI flow for the onboarding process of an Android application, including steps for connecting to a gateway, managing permissions, and reviewing connection status. It utilizes Jetpack Compose for UI components, handles runtime permissions, and interacts with a view model for state management.

classes.name: OnboardingStep
classes.description: Enum representing the different steps in the onboarding flow.

classes.name: GatewayInputMode
classes.description: Enum for gateway input modes, either setup code or manual entry.

classes.name: PermissionToggle
classes.description: Enum for various permission toggles required during onboarding.

classes.name: SpecialAccessToggle
classes.description: Enum for special access toggles, e.g., notification listener.

methods.name: OnboardingFlow
methods.description: Main composable function managing the onboarding UI flow and state.

methods.name: canFinishOnboarding
methods.description: Determines if onboarding can be finished based on connection states.

methods.name: onboardingPrimaryButtonColors
methods.description: Provides button colors for primary action buttons.

methods.name: onboardingTextFieldColors
methods.description: Provides color configuration for text fields.

methods.name: StepRail
methods.description: Displays progress steps in the onboarding process.

methods.name: WelcomeStep
methods.description: UI composable for the welcome step.

methods.name: GatewayStep
methods.description: UI composable for configuring gateway connection details.

methods.name: GuideBlock
methods.description: Reusable component for instruction blocks with a title.

methods.name: GatewayModeToggle
methods.description: UI component to choose between setup code or manual gateway entry.

methods.name: GatewayModeChip
methods.description: Toggle button for gateway mode selection.

methods.name: QuickFillChip
methods.description: Quick fill options for common gateway URLs.

methods.name: ResolvedEndpoint
methods.description: Displays a resolved gateway endpoint in monospace font.

methods.name: StepShell
methods.description: Container for each onboarding step's UI.

methods.name: PermissionsStep
methods.description: UI for granting permissions during onboarding.

methods.name: PermissionToggleRow
methods.description: UI row with toggle for individual permissions.

methods.name: FinalStep
methods.description: Review and final connection status UI.
